<!-- title: v2.1.0 – Assessment of the dry run, monitor fixes on DCs -->
**The monitor now says what each FAIL / WARN means and what to do, and ends with a plain result: OK, PENDING, ATTENTION or ACTION REQUIRED - in a dry run READY / NOT READY FOR THE REAL RUN. It also fixes checks on domain controllers that did not work since at least 2.0.5.**

> The end-to-end lab validation of the 2.x scripts (L1-L20) is in progress ([docs/VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.0/docs/VALIDATION.md)). Validate in your own lab first.

## New

- **Assessment of every FAIL / WARN** in `Watch-CloudUserConformance.ps1` and in the Verify step of `Install-SoaToolkit.ps1`:

  | Class | Meaning |
  |---|---|
  | BLOCKER | prerequisite outside the toolkit - fix it before the real run |
  | ACTION | a toolkit step that is not part of this run creates it |
  | REVIEW | operational finding - it does not block the installation |
  | FOLLOW-UP | reached after the installation (first reconcile run, DC restart, replication) |
  | PLANNED | a step of this run creates it (dry run) |

  The console shows the class and what to do under each item and ends with a summary. CSV, JSON and HTML have the columns `Class` and `Fix`. Status, events and exit code are unchanged.
- **Result instead of "Overall":** the console ends with `Result:` - **OK** (green), **PENDING** (cyan: nothing to do now, for example until the first reconcile run), **ATTENTION** (yellow) or **ACTION REQUIRED** (red) - and a grey `Monitoring status:` with the raw worst status that sets the exit code and the events. Pending items show as `[PEND]`, items this run creates as `[PLAN]`. All signal words and colours: [docs/CHECKS.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.0/docs/CHECKS.md#signal-words-and-colours).
- **Dry run:** `.\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step All ... -WhatIf` ends with **READY FOR THE REAL RUN** or **NOT READY FOR THE REAL RUN**. A first dry run typically shows the scheduled tasks, event log and scripts as `[PLAN]` and the users that are not yet in the PSO group as `[PEND]` - the expected picture.
- **[docs/CHECKS.md](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.0/docs/CHECKS.md):** every check, where its target state comes from and what to do.

## Fixed

- **Monitor on domain controllers** (2.0.5-2.0.8): a variable replaced a parameter of the data collection on every DC. As a result:
  - the audit policy was "not readable";
  - the events 3097 / 3098 were always counted as 0;
  - Kerberos failures of cloud users were never reported ("The specified query is invalid");
  - on a DC that is also an agent host, the provisioning agent was always reported as missing - also by the scheduled monitor, at every run.
- **`-Mode` of SetMode could be ignored** (2.0.5-2.0.8) when Delegate ran in the same call (`-Step Delegate, SetMode -Mode Enforced`): the requested mode was not applied. `-Step SetMode` on its own was not affected.
- Monitor: an empty WARN "Conformance errors" before the first deployment, and an empty GPO name in the KIR check.

A new static check (`tools/Test-SoaScriptScope.ps1`) reports variables that replace a parameter of the same name in other case. Run against 2.0.8, it finds the lines behind both defects.

## Upgrade from 2.0.8

1. Replace the toolkit files and keep your `SoaToolkit.config.psd1`; there are no new keys.
2. Run `.\Install-SoaToolkit.ps1 -Step All -WhatIf` and read the assessment at the end, then run it without `-WhatIf` (it asks for confirmation before changes with a high impact; `-Confirm:$false` for an unattended run). **DeployTasks** puts the fixed monitor on every host.
3. Script sensors and event-based monitoring: nothing changes - the exit code and the events still follow the raw status (`Monitoring status`). Only the console and HTML show the new result.
4. If you counted on the events 3097 / 3098 of the monitor before switching to Enforced: look at them again with 2.1.0 (or with `Get-SoaEnforcementImpact.ps1`).

Details: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/blob/v2.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)

## Verify the download

Compare the SHA-256 of the asset with the digest GitHub shows next to it. The zip contains `SHA256SUMS.txt` for every file. A build of the same tag has the same contents digest (SHA-256 of `SHA256SUMS.txt`, shown in the job summary of the release workflow).

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\cloudsync-soa-toolkit-2.1.0.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Unblock-File
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mayer-bautechnik/cloudsync-soa-toolkit/compare/v2.0.8...v2.1.0
